goal: Show academic preparedness, program fit, and realistic career direction.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and the exact program you want to study.
Summarize relevant education, performance, projects, and skills.
Show experience that supports the program.
Explain specific modules, specialization, or academic strengths.
Mention faculty, facilities, structure, or academic resources.
Describe short-term and long-term goals after completion.

red_flags: Writing too broadly instead of showing fit
banned_phrases: I have always wanted to go to Ireland
I will do anything to get admitted
this is my way to stay in Ireland
the visa is my main concern
preferred_language: My background in X has prepared me for...
This course aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum offers the specialization I need in...
I intend to develop expertise in...
After completing this course, I plan to...
quality_checklist: The course and institution are named clearly
The document matches the rest of the application
